tools.name: get_health
tools.description: API and Solana RPC health: slot, version, and the LiveLaunch config addresses. No transaction is built.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List LiveLaunch tokens. Each row includes mint, pool, price, market cap, curve progress, currentFeeBps, and protectionEndsAt (null when that token has no launch protection).

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: One LiveLaunch token: price, market cap, curve progress, current fee, launch protection, creator links, and unclaimed creator fees. Read currentFeeBps and protectionEndsAt before trading.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: Fee model for new launches, including the current fee, launch protection, and the Meteora / creator / platform split. For a specific token, use get_token (currentFeeBps, protectionEndsAt).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote a buy (amount is SOL) or a sell (amount is tokens). Returns expectedOut, minOut, the pool fee, and poolFee.protectionEndsAt. Does not build or send a transaction.

tools.name: build_launch_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED launch transaction (token, metadata, Meteora bonding-curve pool, optional creator first buy). Pass mint as the public key of a keypair you generated and sign with that keypair too. If mint is omitted the server generates one and pre-signs only that mint key; the secret is not retur

tools.name: build_buy_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED buy transaction for a LiveLaunch bonding curve. solAmount is decimal SOL. Sign locally with wallet. Does not broadcast.

tools.name: build_sell_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED sell transaction. Pass tokenAmount, tokenAmountRaw, or percent (1–100) of the wallet balance. Sign locally with wallet. Does not broadcast.

tools.name: build_claim_creator_fees_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED transaction that claims the creator trading fees for one LiveLaunch pool to the creator wallet. Pass the creator public key and a mint or pool. Sign locally. Does not broadcast.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "build_launch_tx" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
